name: 4-Deck Waveform Height
author: MiuxH
summary: Adjust the native four-deck waveform height from original to nearly touching.
description: Experimental independent port of the V4 height mod for EP147 2.00. Adds Enable and a 0-100% height control. Uses a firmware-specific native paint hook to adjust only the four-deck layout; keeps native grid heights and restores original geometry when disabled. Does not replace the AZ-MODS core or change audio. Native/emulator runtime testing of this community port is still pending.
